title: No Honey Mustard Dressing (Vegan)
excerpt: Happy being vegan but miss your favorite dressing? Try our vegan friendly No Honey Mustard Dressing as a dip, dressing, and all around fantastic condiment!
content:
Ingredients

  • 2.5 ounces lemon juice
  • 1 garlic clove
  • 1/2 tsp kelp powder
  • 3/4 tbsp. yellow mustard
  • 10 drops stevia
  • 1 tbsp turmeric
  • 2 cups parsnips, small cut
  • 6 ounces sesame oil

Method

  1. In a blender, add all the ingredients and blend until smooth.
  2. Add water-a little bit at a time, about ½ cup, to adjust consistency, if necessary.
